dct_creator_sm: Imada, Jamie (Department of Population Medicine. Ontario Veterinary College. University of Guelph.). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5875-8779
dct_description_sm: An information and consent document provided to Ontario dairy producers informing them of the nature of the research. A semistructured interview guide used to interview 20 Ontario dairy producers, exploring motivation and barriers producers experience with regards to Johne's disease control and general herd biosecurity.
dct_title_s: Supplemental material for interviews on Johne's disease and herd biosecurity
